title: Unbekannter schießt auf 27-Jährigen – BAO Ferrum und Ermittlungsgruppe Telum ermitteln

extraction.summaryEn: A 27-year-old man was grazed in the leg by shots fired by an unknown man in Anita-Berber-Park after a group confronted two men, one of whom drew a pistol. Police are investigating an attempted homicide.
